intent: The slides-mode right rail: a fixed multiplayer/tabs header and slide-title bar over a scrolling Template style + Background stack.
guidance: Mount as the right rail in slides mode. The multiplayer/tabs header and slide-title bar stay fixed while Template style and Background scroll beneath a hover-reveal white overlay thumb. Colours flow through the slides-* tokens shared with SlidesPanel, but the template preview swatch (#e95000/#ffcd00/#100f10) and the gradient fill icon still carry literal hex — tokenise before shipping. The component owns its own tab and fill-type state and takes no props, so the slide name, template, and colour values are hardcoded demo data; lift them to controlled props to wire real content. Give the icon-only buttons (Play, chevrons, Contrast) aria-labels — the editor's e2e suite locates kit surfaces by role/label.

anatomy.description: Fixed top zone: avatar menu, Play/present split, Share button, then the Design / Prototype tab row and 100% zoom control.
Fixed 48px row — slide name ("Slide 1") on the left, a Contrast toggle button on the right.
The section stack below the fixed chrome; a hover/scroll-reveal white overlay thumb, no layout shift.
40px header + a full-width trigger: three-colour preview swatch, name ("Radicle") over typography ("Whyte Inktrap, Inter"), and a chevron.
40px header + a Solid / Gradient / Image segmented control over a colour-chit trigger ("Color 1").

use_when: Rendering the right rail when a slide/composition is the active selection.
You want the Figma-fidelity slides inspector (multiplayer header, Design/Prototype tabs, Template style, Background).
dont_use_when: An element is selected — use the element PropertyPanel / Inspector instead.
You need controlled, host-wired inspector data now — this rail is a self-contained fidelity study with hardcoded values.
states: fill: solid | gradient | image (selected fill type)

tokens.note: Text uses white/opacity utilities (text-white, text-white/70, text-black/90), not tokens; radii (rounded-[5px], rounded-[2.667px]) and type (Inter via inline style, text-[11px]/[13px]) are hardcoded; the template preview swatch hardcodes #e95000/#ffcd00/#100f10 and the gradient fill icon hardcodes #fff.

a11y.role: none — bare <div> rail; no landmark role rendered
a11y.labels: icon-only buttons (Play, chevrons, Contrast) have no aria-label — accessibility gap
a11y.tabs: Design / Prototype are <button>s with visible text but no role=tab / aria-selected
